text:
Olivia Chen: Quick heads-up — aiming to cut v1.9.0 tomorrow. Can people confirm blockers by EOD?

Kevin Patel: CI is flaky on e2e (session persistence tests). I've got a branch with a repro, will open a bugfix PR tonight. If it doesn't land by 15:00 PT tomorrow we should consider delaying the public announce.

Sanja Li: Noted. Can we set a hard merge cutoff? Last time late merges caused version mismatches.

Olivia Chen: Yes — proposing a code freeze at 15:00 PT tomorrow for everything that isn't a critical fix/backport. Backports require a clear justification and @Kevin or @Sanja approval.

Paul Nguyen: For release ops: I'll prepare the tag and release notes once the changelog PRs are merged. Reminder: changelog entries should follow our template (short, one-sentence summary + PR link).

Maria Gomez: Marketing needs a final features bulleted list by 16:30 PT to draft the #announcements post. If we slide, they'll need to know asap so they don't schedule the outbound. @Paul can you ping me when the RC is cut?

release-bot: rc created: refs/tags/v1.9.0-rc.1 by Paul Nguyen at 1765124000 (automated)

Kevin Patel: rc build passed in staging but two intermittent e2e failures still showing in nightly. I'm going to add extra logging and a retry in the fixture — shouldn't change API behavior.

Sanja Li: Suggestion: run a 1-hour canary on 10% traffic after RC deploy, if green -> proceed with full rollout. Saves us from needing to postpone unless it's a critical regression.

Olivia Chen: Agreed on canary. Paul, please configure canary rollout at 10% for 60 minutes and add a manual rollback step. Also update the release checklist item for `version` bump to ensure package.json and docker labels match: `git tag v1.9.0 && git push origin v1.9.0` (do this after we are ready to leave RC).

Paul Nguyen: Will do. I'll also run the release-note generator and paste the draft into the release PR. Maria, will ping when RC is cut and again after canary status.

ci-bot: nightly-e2e job failed on staging: session_persistence_test (flaky) at 1765124500. Logs: https://ci.example.com/build/12345

Maria Gomez: If we end up delaying, please include a quick note in #eng-releases + @all in #announcements explaining "slip due to e2e regressions" and a new ETA. Keep message short.

Olivia Chen: Plan: freeze at 15:00 PT, RC cut at ~16:00 PT, canary 16:30-17:30. If e2e failures aren't resolved by 15:00 PT -> quick vote here to slip to next day and notify marketing. Everyone OK with that?

Kevin Patel: +1 — will try to land the fix before cutoff but no promises. If I can't, I vote slip.

Sanja Li: +1

Paul Nguyen: +1. I'll prepare rollback steps and hold off the public tag push until canary is green.

Maria Gomez: +1 to the plan. If slip, I need the reason + expected new ETA so I can update the schedule.

Olivia Chen: Great — I'll post a final timeline in the morning and remind teams about the 15:00 PT cutoff. If anything changes, reply in this thread.

Kevin Patel: FYI opened PR #4821 for the e2e retry fix. Marked as urgent.

Olivia Chen: Thanks — assigning @Sanja to review for backport approval if needed.

(emoji reactions: :thumbsup: from Paul Nguyen, :eyes: from Maria Gomez)
